latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Generator Japanese to English — Translate Japanese Videos to English.

- Upload Japanese video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), generate and burn in English subtitles, and download as 1080p MP4.
- Automatic cloud backend setup includes token management, session creation, and credits check.
- Supports common export, credits, status, and upload commands via simple prompts.
- Error handling and feedback for unsupported files, large uploads, expired tokens, and rate limits.
- Includes tips for best results and outlines common workflows for translation, editing, and export.
